title: Kissed Algerian Fish Tagine
description: A comforting Algerian dish featuring a papillote of fermented fish seasoning, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This recipe is low in glycemic index, making it suitable for those with dietary restrictions.

ingredients.name: Fish fillets (any white fish, 4)','amount':
ingredients.notes: Fresh cod or haddock work well.

ingredients.name: Ginger (2 tablespoons)','amount':
ingredients.notes: Grated ginger adds a lot of flavor.

ingredients.name: Olive oil (2 tablespoons)','amount':
ingredients.notes: You can use a little more oil if needed.

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large, heatproof Dutch oven or clay tagine over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened and lightly browned (5-7 minutes).
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the ginger and cook for another minute, stirring constantly.
Add the fermented fish seasoning and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the fish fillets and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, until browned and almost cooked through.
Cover the Dutch oven or tagine with a paper-thin sheet of parchment paper, or a piece of aluminum foil that has been rubbed with a little olive oil.
Transfer the Dutch oven or tagine to the preheated oven and cook for 10-12 minutes, or until the fish is cooked through and the seasoning is bubbly and fragrant.
Remove the Dutch oven or tagine from the oven and sprinkle with parsley.
Serve hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
